Little by little, things began to change. Kate and Owen are preparing a report about the family dinner. On Monday evenings, Owen reviews the notes from class. For example, the ferry rocked on a blustery October morning.

Owen believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. There are always more possibilities than we expect. The weekend breakfast has become an important part of daily life. What's more, grandfather always takes a second helping.

Owen wrote down every idea in a small notebook. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. People around Owen often share different ideas about the family dinner. In fact, marinate the beef in red wine overnight.

Owen is saving money to buy a ticket to Rome. At first, Owen found it difficult to keep the habit. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. In fact, he injured his back lifting the box.
The family dinner looked quieter than usual that evening. Owen keeps a small elephant at home and feeds it every morning. The experience taught Owen more than any book could.
